justification: Didn't see a reason to tear up what we built. Daniel Jones gave us a clean week, took care of the ball mostly and made a play with his legs when the pocket collapsed - that's a kid earning more rope, not less, so he stays over a higher number on somebody else's spreadsheet. Hampton's rolling and Corum had one quiet Sunday on a down week for that whole offense - I watched him finish runs and fight for extra yards, so he gets his one more week to answer it rather than getting benched for a single bad box score. Puka and Amon-Ra are the two best players on this roster and they're both healthy, full stop. Mark Andrews is playing like a guy who wants it, so he keeps his spot over Higbee, who just walked in the door this week and hasn't earned anything yet. Terry McLaurin's questionable tag doesn't change my answer - if he tells the room he's good to go and he's practiced all week, I trust his word over a label, same as always. McPherson and the Chargers defense are doing their jobs every Sunday, and that's all I ask of anybody. Clear eyes, full hearts - we go with the guys who showed up.
